sources.label: Bureau Veritas full physical silver inventory audit (June 30, 2026 parcel list; report July 17, 2026)

reserveReview.rationale: Bureau Veritas' July 17, 2026 report covers the complete June 30 Parcel Ownership List: 66 HERAEUS Good Delivery silver bars of 1000 troy ounces and 999.0 fineness, comprising 64 at Brink's Hong Kong and two at Malca-Amit Singapore. It records a 100% physical audit, bar-number checks, and weighing, with no anomalies identified. The re-curated direct reserve bucket is therefore 100% physical silver at the report's June 30 inventory date. The newer issuer dashboard observation of September 21 (73 bars, 72,927 ounces) is retained only as later issuer disclosure and does not re-date this independently inspected composition. The inventory audit does not reconcile token liabilities.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Bureau Veritas identifies 64 silver bars at Brink's Hong Kong and two at Malca-Amit Singapore in the June 30, 2026 parcel list, physically inspected in July. These are historical named custodians, not a current vault-share allocation; the current 73-bar issuer dashboard does not establish custody of all additional bars. Segregation, insolvency and rehypothecation terms remain unknown.
